description: This module can be used to enable or disable an Icinga2 feature.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This is the feature name to enable or disable.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: If set to present and feature is disabled, then feature is enabled. If set to present and feature is already enabled, then nothing is changed. If set to absent and feature is enabled, then feature is disabled. If set to absent and feature is already disabled, then nothing is changed. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

examples:
- name: Enable ido-pgsql feature
  community.general.icinga2_feature:
    name: ido-pgsql
    state: present

- name: Disable api feature
  community.general.icinga2_feature:
    name: api
    state: absent
